metadata.case_name: NG CHEUNG SOU CHUN CECILIA v. SAVILLS PROPERTY MANAGEMENT LTD AND ANOTHER

plaintiff.occupation_before: Regional Office Manager of an Italian company
plaintiff.expected_occupation_after: General Manager at an education consultancy company

injuries.description: small haematoma on occipital region (1 cm)
source: she was found to have suffered from a small haematoma (1 cm) on her occipital region and right elbow dislocation.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of other or unspecified sites of head

source: she was found to have suffered from a small haematoma (1 cm) on her occipital region and right elbow dislocation.
Closed reduction of her elbow dislocation was performed. The elbow was put in plaster for immobilisation for a week.

In the opinion of Dr Yip, the treatment received by Ng for her elbow dislocation was standard and appropriate. She has achieved maximal medical improvement. Her loss of some terminal extension of the right elbow and terminal flexion will not be of any clinical significance due to the compensatory dexterity of the adjacent joint of the elbow. The impairments are likely to be permanent.

manifestations.description: Small haematoma (1 cm) on occipital region
Occasional numbness in the right arm and hand
Loss of some terminal extension of the right elbow and terminal flexion
Mild decrease in efficiency in certain types of household chores

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Ceased her pre-accident yoga and aerobic exercises.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Inability to handle household work such as lifting the mattress or moving heavy furniture; could do house cleaning but needed temporary part-time domestic help.
Loss of the job opportunity as General Manager at Chan's education consultancy company (employment due to commence on 2006-11-01; salary HK$35,000 per month plus one month's bonus).
